text:
I'd like to share my positive experience with this physiotherapy clinic. 💙

I took my brother for treatment of Office Syndrome. Initially, we didn't inform the clinic that my brother was undergoing cancer treatment. They had already prepared an electrical muscle stimulation device. However, upon learning of his cancer, and knowing that electrical stimulation could potentially stimulate cancer cells, they immediately canceled the treatment for my brother's safety.

What impressed me most was the incredible kindness of the staff and physiotherapists. They showed no frustration or displeasure at all, even though they had to cancel the entire preparation. They were incredibly patient, explained everything in detail, and even taught us physiotherapy exercises that could be done correctly at home. 🙏

Importantly, the clinic didn't charge us anything, despite the time and equipment they had already prepared. I could truly feel their care and professionalism.

Thank you for prioritizing patient safety and providing such sincere advice.
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a physiotherapy clinic that offers knowledge, professionalism, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. 💙
